briefings.title: World Economic Forum’s Chief Economists Outlook: September 2026

people.name: Ufuk Akcigit
people.role: Deputy Chief Economist and Director of Private Markets, World Bank Group

briefings.tldr: Despite ongoing disruptions from geopolitical conflicts, fragile energy markets, and lingering inflation, chief economists show a significant rebound in sentiment, with 56% expecting global economic conditions to remain stable or improve.

briefings.title: World Economic Forum Global Gender Gap Report Media Briefing 2026

people.name: Sue Duke
people.role: Managing Director for EMEA & LATAM, LinkedIn

people.name: Yann Zopf
people.role: Head of Media, World Economic Forum

briefings.tldr: The World Economic Forum’s Global Gender Gap Report 2026 shows the overall global gender gap index at 69.2%, meaning it will take 120 years at the current rate of change to reach full parity, with leadership parity stretched out to 90 years.

briefings.title: AI's real impact on jobs - what it means for you, your company and future generations
briefings.tldr: Artificial intelligence has created a foresight "fog" for modern business, accelerating job task changes to 9% annually by 2026 and requiring that workforce reskilling be treated as part of the core infrastructure stack rather than an afterthought.
